official_definition: (Triple Ultimate Trigger: Send three cards from the opposing deck to the Trash. If each of those cards' cost is lower than this Ultimate's, it's a hit.)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Triple Ultimate Trigger] or [Triple Ultimate Trigger: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Triple Ultimate Trigger]", "give [Triple Ultimate Trigger]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
